topic: Closing your oldest credit card can drop your score, because it shortens your average account age
title: Closing Your Oldest Credit Card Can Wreck Your Score
description:
Why closing that credit card you never use might be a bad idea. The 'average age of accounts' is a key part of your credit score, and closing your oldest one can shorten it instantly, making you look like a riskier borrower.
